notes.title: A Clockwork Ley-Line: Flowers Falling in the Morning Mist - Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43167581/b45f5b2bb082610dd6b073effa477dfd72e87617.png[/img]

We've kept you waiting long enough and today we're proud to announce that the FINAL episode in the Ley-Line Trilogy is now available on Steam! If you've been waiting to see the trilogy finished before buying, now is your chance! Plus the series is on sale right now so don't miss out!
